title: You Think Tiny Favors Stay Harmless, Yet One Window Sticker Sold Giant Lawn Signs
description:
You think tiny favors stay completely harmless! Yet one small sticker sold giant lawn signs! This is the true story of Freedman and Fraser's study. Here is what went wrong in sunny Palo Alto.
